sentences.text: 1  NAFR  HIGH COURT of CHHATTISGARH, BILASPUR  MCRC No. 8430 of 2023
Vijay Mehra S/o Ramprasad Mehra Aged About 24 Years

------Applicant  VERSUS   State of Chhattisgarh through Station House Officer, Police  Station Gandhinagar, District : Sarguja, Chhattisgarh.
 -------Non-applicant
For Applicant : Mr. Sangeeta Soni, Advocate
For Non-applicant-State : Mr. Sushil Sahu, Panel Lawyer
SB: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge  ORDER ON BOARD  15/12/2023 1.

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail, as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No.703/2021 registered at Police Station - Gandhinagar, District - Sarguja, Chhattisgarh for the offences punishable under Section 363, 366 and 376 (2) (n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and u/s. 5 (l)/6 of the Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences, Act, 2012.

entities.text: Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences, Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Pursuant to the notice issued by this Court, victim along with her father is present before this Court through virtual mode from D.L.S.A., Dist. Sarguja, Chhattisgarh and they have raised strong objection in grant of bail to the applicant.
3.

After arguing for sometime, learned counsel for the applicant seeks persmission of this Court that he may be permitted to withdraw this application at this stage with liberty to repeat the prayer at appropriate stage.
4. In view of the submissions made by the learned Counsel for the applicant, the application is dimisssed as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
